figures.caption: One product column splits a full accumulator into a limb and a carry.
figures.alt: Five annotated details at the first after_product_partial show accumulator fffffffe00000001 and outgoing carry fffffffe. Each input starts with limbs ffffffff and 00000001. The first stored product limb is one; the seven later limbs remain zero after clearing.

figures.caption: The separate carry decides reduction when the stored low sum is below the modulus.
figures.alt: Six annotated details after_add_limbs show the low 128-bit sum 2^128 minus320, a separate carry of one, both residue inputs 2^128 minus160 and modulus 2^128 minus159. The stored low sum alone compares below the modulus, but the 129-bit total still needs subtraction.

figures.caption: Reduction finishes in private scratch before copying to the caller.
figures.alt: Six annotated details after_reduce_accumulate show saved bit index minus one, stack pointer 100106b8, private remainder one and the separate one constant. Caller output remains a5 bytes. The modulus is five, and the 80-byte frame remains allocated before publication and restoration.

figures.caption: Modular power publishes its result before restoring the private frame.
figures.alt: Six annotated details after_power_publish show all sixteen output bytes e6 0a followed by fourteen zero bytes, the still-active 96-byte frame, the exhausted private exponent and low power accumulator. The modulus is 3233 and original exponent 17. Restoration has not yet executed.
